about: Mitutoyo 513-404-10E lever dial test indicator on a magnetic stand: four links, eleven CAD materials. Black base, clamps and knob; chrome rods; satin-chrome indicator body; a white dial under its crystal, as the 513-404's; the base's label and ground pole pieces.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: corrected to the real product: the dial made white, as a real Mitutoyo 513-404 (the CAD's is yellow)
triangles_why: the stand's knurled clamp knobs, the indicator's knurled bezel and the rods' knurls hold the seams-kept simplifier at 14.8k even at its 1.6 % bound; positions-only (11.1k) would risk the thin pointer, stylus and label, and no link is hidden enough to drop (4 links, all visible)
download_why: the 15k-triangle allowance's geometry is ~0.46 MB on its own; with the AO already down to 512 (1.1 mm a texel on a 230 mm stand) the model lands just over 0.5 MB

dti_black.about: black enamel: the magnetic base, the clamps, the switch knob, the dial's bezel

dti_dial.about: the 513-404's white dial face under its glossy crystal

unsure.what: the bezel keeps the CAD's black
